title: Quezon activates task force as El Niño threatens farms, water supply

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon — The Quezon provincial government has activated its El Niño Task Force and stepped up preparations to mitigate the potential effects of prolonged dry conditions and extreme heat on agriculture, public health and community safety. “Our El Niño Task Force is now activated. We have already identified the measures we will undertake because we recognize that this could be an extreme event. Our planning and the interventions we provide will be commensurate with the severity of El Niño,” Provincial Agriculturist Ana Clarissa Mariano said in Filipino during a special episode of “Kapitolyo Podcast” on Oct. 20.
